articles.title: Walmart Canada launches AI shopping assistant Sparky
articles.summary: MISSISSAUGA — Walmart Inc. has brought its AI chatbot Sparky to Canada, more than a year after the retailer first rolled out the shopping assistant in the United States.

articles.title: Ontario completes removal of bike lanes on stretch of Bloor Street West in Etobicoke
articles.summary: The Doug Ford government says it has completed the removal of a section of bike lanes on Bloor Street West in Etobicoke, restoring vehicle lanes along a 1.2-kilometre stretch of roadway the province argues is needed to ease traffic congestion. In a release issued Friday, the province said work has wrapped up between Clissold Road […]

articles.title: Large fire breaks out at Brampton truck yard
articles.summary: Fire crews were called to the scene of a massive fire that tore through a large truck yard in Brampton. articles.title: 'We've had enough': Condo owners rally at Queen's Park to call for change in how condo boards operate
articles.summary: A group of condo owners took their fight for legislative change to Queen's Park this week to demand reforms they say would protect the 1.9 million people in Ontario who live in condos.

articles.title: How Brampton's youngest councillor plans to bring a 'generational' change to city hall
articles.summary: Sukhman Sangha, 29, became Brampton's youngest regional councillor following Monday's municipal election. Representing wards 9 and 10 on the city's northeast borders, he says he has strong plans to advocate for the community where housing and population growth are on the rise, but services haven't kept up.

articles.title: City traffic agent dead after being struck by driver of dump truck in Toronto, police say
articles.summary: A city traffic agent has died after being struck by a driver of a dump truck in the city's Thorncliffe Park neighbourhood Thursday, Toronto police say.

articles.title: 4 hospitalized as Toronto police investigate home invasion, shooting at Bridle Path home
articles.summary: Toronto police say they're investigating a home invasion after three people were shot inside a North York residence early Thursday. They say four people were injured, and two are in life-threatening condition.

articles.title: Man dead after being struck by two vehicles in Richmond Hill: York police
articles.summary: A 27-year-old man has died in Richmond Hill after being struck by a vehicle Wednesday night, York police said.

articles.title: Vaughan real estate agent pleads guilty to extortion plot in Project South case
articles.summary: A Vaughan real estate agent pleaded guilty to an extortion charge Wednesday for a plot discovered through wire taps in sweeping police corruption probe Project South.
